name: Álora (Spain)
description: Red field charged towards the hoist with a yellow lion rampant beside a yellow castle with blue door and windows, the devices of the municipal arms.
history: The arms and flag of Álora were approved by the Junta de Andalucía on 28 October 2004; on the cloth of the flag, at 1/3 of its length from the hoist, are placed the charges of the heraldic arms in yellow with the door and windows of the castle in blue, in the proportion 3/4 of the width of the flag.
